description: In deploy/deploy.sh, after unpack (mv STAGING -> RELEASE) and before the symlink swap: 'rm -rf $RELEASE/.next/cache; ln -s /srv/guru-web/next-cache $RELEASE/.next/cache'. Because .next/cache is excluded from the tarball it never exists at unpack; the symlink means guru writes THROUGH it into the guru-owned target (mkdir of subdirs like fetch-cache resolves through the symlink). Release stays deploy:deploy — do NOT change lines 66/127. Also fix the wrong comment at lines 123-125: next start runs as guru (guru-web.service User=guru), not deploy. Depends on the cache dir existing (child d295d350). Done: deploy.sh updated + committed; comment corrected.
